name: io.github.thealirazadev/mcp-store-tools
title: Shopify Store Tools
description: Read-only Shopify catalog, collections, and policies for AI agents. Try it with --demo.

environmentVariables.name: SHOPIFY_STOREFRONT_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Storefront API access token (read-only public data)

environmentVariables.name: SHOPIFY_COUNTRY
environmentVariables.description: Optional ISO country code for local currency and prices, such as GB

environmentVariables.name: SHOPIFY_LANGUAGE
environmentVariables.description: Optional language code for translated content, such as FR
